source.text: If the Vendor delivers any Equipment after 5 December 2026, a penalty shall accrue against the Vendor for every day of delay beyond that date, at the rate of 1.5% of the invoice value of the Equipment so delayed per day. The aggregate penalty payable in respect of any delivery shall in no circumstances exceed 12% of that invoice value.

9.3 Where the Buyer places a single Purchase Order for forty (40) or more units of Equipment, the Vendor shall allow the Buyer a discount of 6% on the price of that Purchase Order, and the invoice shall show the discounted amount.
